sloka: ततः प्रियम् वाक्यम् उपेत्य राक्षसामहाअर्थम् अष्टौ अभिवाद्य रावणम् ।विहाय लंकाम् सहिताः प्रतस्थिरेयतो जनस्थानम् अलक्ष्य दर्शनाः ॥३-५४-२९॥
transliteration: tataḥ priyam vākyam upetya rākṣasāmahāartham aṣṭau abhivādya rāvaṇam ।vihāya laṁkām sahitāḥ pratasthireyato janasthānam alakṣya darśanāḥ ॥3-54-29॥

translations.english: The eight demons were glad to hear the pleasing and meaningful words of Ravana. They offered him salutations and left Lanka in the direction of Janasthana without being seen by any one.
